newsitem.title: UK: European vegetable oil end quiet day little change.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oil end quiet day little change.

text.p: European vegetable oils finished a quiet day with prices little changed and few trades on the board.
Traders said there was no sign of any follow-through from Tuesday's active trading in palm oil which was triggered by fears that Indonesia will raise its export duty on palm oil.
However, some traders believed that any increase in the duty will be small.

"Looking at the prices over the past week or so I would say that any increase in the export duty on crude palm oil and olein is only likely be a few dollars, nothing to get worried about," said one trader.
At the close of business crude palm oil cif Europe was unchanged after Feb traded at $570 in a switch with Mar at $565 a tonne.
Products closed $2.50 to $5 down with no further business reported during the afternoon.
Lauric oils closed with coconut oil around $5 down and palmkernel oil $2.50 lower.
Soft oils closed with sellers 0.50 to one guilder lower after Feb soy oil traded at 99 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
May/Jul and Aug/Oct rape oil was offered at the close at a 0.25 guilders premium over soy oil.
